title: Review of c30's hash-fixes finding: determinism fix confirmed across processes; 2 fresh seeds at sigma 0.02 give late bursts 29 and 0 against shadow 0 with the commonest type at 0.89-0.93 (Supported)
summary: (1) calib/dettest.py run twice in separate processes (runs/det_a.txt, runs/det_b.txt): seeds 0, 0, 3, 3 give populations 1965, 1965, 3065, 3065 and replication-log hashes 605e5c617e, 605e5c617e, dee7acfe0f, dee7acfe0f, identical to the claim's det1.txt. (2) knobs/sweep_run.py, copied unchanged and run from its own directory with the claim's parameters (sigma 0.02, n0 2000, T=20000), on fresh seeds 20 and 21 (runs/sweep.log, runs/sig02n_s2*.json): it runs and writes to its runs/ directory, so the path fix works. Late (t>=2000) significant new kinds: 29 and 0, shadow 0 and 0; top-20 overlap with the first window at the end 0.0 and 0.55; commonest type 0.89-0.93 of particles throughout. (3) Labkit re-run of knobs/world.py on seed 20 with the same parameters (rerun/seed20, 2000 steps).

observations.finding: runs/sweep.log: seed 20 late_cohort=29 vs shadow 0 with ov_end=0.0 and top share 0.89-0.93; seed 21 late_cohort=0, ov_end=0.55; runs/det_a.txt = runs/det_b.txt = claim det1.txt

seeds_run.result: pass: late burst (29 kinds, shadow 0), commonest type still 0.89-0.93

controls_run.finding: per-run RB shadow computed by sweep_run.py on my seeds (runs/sig02n_s2*.json)

verdicts.limitation: Two fresh seeds. My seed 20 burst (29) is larger than any of the claim's six (max 5) though smaller than c32's 111, so the burst size distribution is wide; the corrected wording (occasional late bursts with partial or even full top-20 replacement, the dominant type holding most particles) fits, while 'rarer than the moving landscape' rests on the claim's control, which I did not re-run. The labkit re-run is short (2000 steps) and only confirms the world runs with these parameters.
